## Steps journey

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
timeline <- data.frame(
  time = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
  ypos = c(.5, -.5, .5, -.5, .5),
  label = c("Fingerprinting:\nidentifying people from walking\nwith labeled walking data", "Step counting\n with labeled data", "Step counting\nin NHANES", "Mortality\nin NHANES", "Fingerprinting\n in NHANES")
)

ggplot(timeline, aes(x = time, y = ypos, label = label)) +
  # Timeline arrow (centered at y = 0)
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = min(time),
      xend = max(time) + 0.5,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0
    ),
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "inches")),
    linewidth = 1.2,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  
  # Vertical connectors
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = time,
      xend = time,
      y = 0,
      yend = ypos
    ),
    color = "gray30",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # Text bubbles
  geom_label(fill = "#6DB6FF",
             color = "black",
             label.size = 0.3) +
  # Clean theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlim(0, max(timeline$time) + 1) +
  ylim(-2, 2)
```


---

## Steps journey

```{r}
timeline = timeline %>% 
  mutate(col = if_else(time == 1, "col1", "col2")) 
ggplot(timeline, aes(x = time, y = ypos, label = label, fill = col)) +
  # Timeline arrow (centered at y = 0)
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = min(time),
      xend = max(time) + 0.5,
      y = 0,
      yend = 0
    ),
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "inches")),
    linewidth = 1.2,
    color = "gray30"
  ) +
  
  # Vertical connectors
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = time,
      xend = time,
      y = 0,
      yend = ypos
    ),
    color = "gray30",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # Text bubbles
  geom_label(color = "black",
             label.size = 0.3) +
  # Clean theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  xlim(0, max(timeline$time) + 1) +
  ylim(-2, 2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FF6DB6", "#6DB6FF")) 
```


## Fingerprinting with labeled walking
90-100\% accuracy  in two datasets of 30 and 150 individuals

34\% rank-1 accuracy in 13,367 individuals: correct individual from everyone identified 34\% of the time!
